title: Login with valid credentials
description: Authenticate using the login form and confirm access to the employee list.

title: View employee list and search
description: Open the employee list page and search/filter employees.
steps: Enter a search query into the search box
Verify the table filters results based on search input

title: Add a new employee
description: Add a new employee using the add employee workflow.
steps: Fill Name, Email, and Position fields
Verify the new employee appears in the list

title: Edit an existing employee
description: Update an employee's details using the edit workflow.
steps: Select Edit for an existing employee
Update the employee's Name, Email, or Position
Verify the employee details are updated in the list

title: Delete an employee
description: Remove an employee using the delete workflow.
steps: Select Delete for an existing employee
Verify the employee no longer appears in the list
